run_VQA_training: run the VQA model training loop with question-only or question-image input types using argparse CLI
run_VQA_evaluation: run the VQA model evaluation on a validation or test split and log accuracy metrics
run_multiprocess_training: run multi-process VQA training with shared model parameters across GPU workers
run_checkpoint_resume: run training resumed from a saved checkpoint file with preserved model state and args
run_cached_training: run VQA training with image data caching enabled to reduce environment loading overhead
